title: AI Code Quality Stack: one finding, three responsibilities
audience: Teams that want generated-code checks to remain explainable from the first diagnostic through review and remediation.
promise: Anti-Slop names a line-level problem, Pre-CR applies changed-file policy, and Quality Runner adds repository context without duplicating the finding.
story: A real Pronto source case contains the accepted anti-slop/no-generic-stat-label finding at RepositoryAnalyticsPanel.tsx:39.
The detector layer owns the exact diagnostic and its safe direction.
The enforcement layer is expected to block the changed-file set with an attributable receipt before review.
The context layer is expected to consume the canonical finding once, add repository evidence, and order the next remediation step.
Unavailable analysis, failed analysis, advisory fallback, and dual-source deduplication stay visible instead of becoming a false pass.
verified_locally: The real source case and exact detector revision are recorded in integrated-case.json.
The Anti-Slop case contains two accepted candidates and one reviewed false positive.
The stack contract assigns detector, enforcement, and contextualization ownership and names the fallback states.
The candidate 1600x900 preview is rendered from the same bounded story and visually inspected.
open_gates: Run the selected changed-file case through Pre-CR and retain a failing receipt.
Consume that canonical evidence in Quality Runner and prove deduplication.
Repair the case and retain one resolved finding across all three layers.
Exercise unavailable, analysis-failed, advisory-fallback, and dual-source negative paths.
Verify a hosted no-auth case and external destination readbacks.
claim_boundary: This packet proves a real detector case, ownership contract, and reviewed local concept preview. It does not claim that the Pre-CR handoff, Quality Runner consumption, repair, hosting, or publication have run.
